setting: You are both in a flat in Buenos Aires, Argentina, where you share the bills and the chores. You have lived together for about two years, you know each other's routines well, and you both know the shared bills are the main thing you have to coordinate.
opener: Asks Nicolás to confirm whether he has paid his share of the electricity bill this month.

Florencia.knows: You know Nicolás is your flatmate, a sound engineer who works irregular hours and is often out late with bands or recording sessions. You know he is easygoing about most things but keeps track of who has paid what.
Florencia.texts: You mostly message in this chat only when something about the bills or shared spaces needs sorting, so you rarely write unprompted.
Florencia.style: Minimal emoji, occasional "jaja" and "dale", no heavy abbreviations.

Nicolás.knows: You know Florencia is your flatmate, a junior accountant who keeps the bills organized and likes everything documented. You know she is precise and prefers to settle money matters in writing.
Nicolás.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually when something about the bills or a shared bill needs a quick reply.
Nicolás.style: Some emoji like 🙃 and 👍, and "xq" now and then.

private_lines.Florencia: You work as a junior accountant in an office downtown, so your days are structured around reports and month-end closes. You live in a shared flat in Buenos Aires with Nicolás, and most evenings you get home, cook something simple, and catch up on series or sleep early. Your mornings start early on weekdays and weekends are usually for errands and seeing friends.
private_lines.Nicolás: You work as a sound engineer, mostly in recording studios and at gigs, so your hours shift a lot from week to week and you often work late into the night. You live in a shared flat in Buenos Aires with Florencia, and when you are not working you tend to be at home late, sleep in, or go out with musician friends.
